description: Revision history of one WASDE projection figure (default ending_stocks) across monthly reports — how the estimate for a commodity and marketing year moved as successive WASDE reports landed. Use to study estimate revisions; use get_wasde_projection instead for the full current balance sheet. Read-only lookup of stored projections; no API key. Returns up to 24 monthly report values, oldest first, each with its report date and unit, for the requested commodity, attribute, and country (default WORLD).

attribute.description: Projection attribute (beginning_stocks, production, imports, exports, domestic_consumption, ending_stocks)

country.description: Country code (WORLD, US, BR, AR). Default: WORLD aggregate

name: get_wasde_history
